observations: Front wheel has a red fork blade.
Rear wheel has a black fork blade.
The bike is leaning against a blue plastic barrel.
The frame has a 'T' logo on the down tube, but the full brand name is not legible.
The bike is in an outdoor, possibly dusty or wet, environment.

claims.evidence: photo 0 shows a carbon fiber frame with a 'T' logo on the down tube.

risks.risk: The bike may have a broken or seized bottom bracket.
risks.proof: A video of the crankset being spun by hand.

risks.risk: The drivetrain (gears) may be stripped or non-functional.
risks.proof: A video of the bike being pedaled through all gear ratios.

risks.risk: The bike may have a structural crack in the carbon frame.
risks.proof: A clear, close-up photo of the frame joints and the 'T' logo area.

risks.risk: The bike may be missing essential accessories like a water bottle cage or pedals.
risks.proof: A photo of the bike with all accessories attached.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the bottom bracket being turned by hand.
Video of the bike being pedaled through all gear settings.
Close-up photo of the 'T' logo and the frame joints to check for cracks.
Photo of the bike with pedals and water bottle cage attached.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
